hero.subtitle: Original paintings — each one of a kind.

marqueeQuote: Art is a line around your thoughts

showcase.title: Works people come back to
showcase.lede: A selection of paintings still waiting for a home. Spin the ring to look at each one — click the work in the centre to open its page.

about.title: Paintings that won’t be repeated
about.text1: Viktorumm is an online gallery of original paintings. No prints, no reproductions: every work exists as a single piece, and once it is sold it leaves the catalogue.
about.text2: Some works are marked “Available on commission” — those can be ordered again even after the original has found its owner.

choose.title: Choose a work
choose.text: Browse the catalogue or the gallery. Every painting’s page lists its size and technique, and many show it hanging in a room.

order.title: Place an order
order.text: Add the painting to your cart and enter delivery details. No account needed.

pay.title: Pay on delivery
pay.text: Cash on delivery: you pay at the post office once the painting is in your hands.

receive.title: Collect it from Nova Poshta
receive.text: Follow the order status on the site or in our Telegram bot.

closing.title: Find your painting
closing.text: Questions about a work, its size or delivery? Write to us — we’ll help you choose.
